subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct voice.**

The teacher told the students that they had to complete the complex project that had been assigned to them the previous week, as it was a crucial part of their curriculum which would determine their final grades.

options.text: "You must complete this complex project that has been assigned to you last week, as it is a crucial part of your curriculum which will determine your final grades," the teacher said to the students.
"You had to complete the complex project that was assigned to you last week, as it was a crucial part of your curriculum which would determine your final grades," the teacher said to the students.
"You must complete this complex project that was assigned to you last week, as it is a crucial part of your curriculum which determine your final grades," the teacher said to the students.

"You must complete that complex project that was assigned to you the previous week, as it is a crucial part of your curriculum which will determine your final grades," the teacher said to the students.

solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. "You must complete this complex project that was assigned to you last week, as it is a crucial part of your curriculum which determine your final grades," .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The question requires us to convert a sentence from indirect speech to direct speech while maintaining the correct tense, structure, and meaning.
 
• Direct speech is written in quotation marks and directly states the speaker's words without paraphrasing.
 
• Among the options, option 3 correctly follows the rules of direct speech and maintains the grammatical accuracy of the original sentence.
 
• Option 1 uses "this complex project that has been assigned," which is incorrect because the project was assigned in the past.
 
• Option 2 changes the tense incorrectly by using "had to complete" and "was a crucial part," which misrepresents the immediacy of the teacher's instruction.
 
• Option 4 uses "that complex project" instead of "this complex project," which slightly alters the proximity implied in the original statement.

Correct sentence: *"You must complete this complex project that was assigned to you last week, as it is a crucial part of your curriculum which determine your final grades," the teacher said to the students.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Direct Speech:** Quoting the exact words spoken by the speaker. Example: She said, "I am happy."
 
• **Indirect Speech:** Paraphrasing or reporting what the speaker said without quoting their exact words. Example: She said that she was happy.
 
• **Tense Consistency:** When converting indirect to direct speech, ensure the tense aligns with the original context and meaning.
